svg.text: Guard: what may be read, and what may leave
guard.py with tools.py (Toolbox._path, _outside, _scope). Refusals reach the model as text. working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12.
Reading a path the model names
read, tree; grep and glob use _scope (same rules)
→ the first declared or granted folder holding it
real path (symlinks resolved) inside a root,
not denylisted or inside application storage
real path outside the home folder?
hidden part, denylist, or own data?
inside a folder granted this session?
once → read · session → folder granted, read
no → refused: 'do not ask for it again'
protected and peresearch's own: never; links to
a hidden target skipped in allowed folders;
live evidence scope checked before requests;
secrets redacted by own + gitleaks rules;
revocation cancels retries; no secret remains
audit: channel, characters, count; no content
a query or URL holding a secret → refused
fetch opens only URLs a search returned
a paragraph with a secret is never stored; new rules
grep lines, read text and excerpts redacted
ANSI escapes and control characters removed
time, event, channel, counts; never the text
any part of the path; tokenizer.md stays readable
